phrases.restaurant-table: on a restaurant table laid for two
phrases.outdoor-table: on a table outside a café

phrases.paper-menu: the menu lies flat on the table
phrases.clipboard: the menu is clipped to a plain wooden clipboard
phrases.table-stand: the menu stands upright in a plain table stand

phrases.daylight: soft natural daylight from one side
phrases.warm-indoor: warm indoor light, as in a café in the late afternoon
phrases.soft-studio: even, soft studio light with gentle shadows

phrases.three-quarter: a three-quarter view from a seated diner's height

phrases.hands: one pair of hands holding or touching the menu naturally, no face in the frame

review.look: Put the output beside the artwork. Same elements, in the same places and proportions, on the menu? Only perspective and light may differ.
review.fix: The design changed. Reproduce the attached artwork exactly as supplied; change only its perspective and the light that falls on it.

review.plain: the words changed or were added
review.look: Read every word in the output against the artwork, letter by letter. A changed, missing or extra word anywhere in the image (signs, screens, packaging, clothing) fails.
review.fix: The words changed. Keep every word exactly as in the artwork, and add no text anywhere else in the image.

review.look: Compare the logo with the artwork: the same shape, proportions and colours, not redrawn or simplified.
review.fix: The logo changed. Keep the logo exactly as in the artwork: its shape, its proportions and its colours.

review.look: Under the scene's light, do the artwork's colours still read as the brand colours in brand/tokens.css? A different hue fails; a natural shadow or highlight passes.
review.fix: The colours shifted. Keep the artwork's colours as supplied; only the scene's light may fall on them.

review.look: Look over the whole image: any other logo, brand name, maker mark, label or watermark fails.
review.fix: Another brand appeared. Remove every other logo, brand name, maker mark, label and watermark; leave every object plain.

review.look: Does the artwork sit on the menu the way print or a screen really would: following its surface, at a believable size, nothing floating or melted?
review.fix: It does not look real. Make the artwork sit on the menu the way real print or a real screen would, at a believable size.

artwork.accepts.why: this recipe takes a print menu or price list (a flyer or table tent also fits); re-run selection (archetypes/mockup/select.md) or make that asset first

artwork.pass.why: refuse: only a sample that passed its checks is mocked up; fix the asset first
